lesson_text: STR_943 OC+EpsChg composite achieves Grade A (52.2, SR 1.312, CAGR 17.1%, MDD 22.1%) but C9 same-day DD brake inflates SR. Lines 104-106 compute dd_pct from same-day cumulative NAV and apply to same-day return without t-1 lag. MRS overlay also uses same-month FRED (C11). Pure factor signal is robust (OOS SR 1.126, retention 0.80, IC stable 1.06 ratio). After C9+C11 fix, expect SR to drop ~10-20% per L-465~470 precedent but base alpha likely survives as Grade A or strong B.
core_reference: L-465~470 (VT/DD/FM same-day circular SR 25-50% overestimation, Session 37-38); L-441 (MRS/FRED month-end timing); C9 enforcement per judge_pit_enforcement.md
